name: Shangri Enfer
source:
"If only I didn't have this kind of power..."

Welcome to Shangri;Enfer, where people prioritize logic over emotion and some are born with psychological abilities, depending on each person's mental capacity. Thanks to this, Shangri;Enfer enjoys low crime rates, so such things as robbery or attacks rarely happen. This peace is short-lived, though, when a mysterious figure named Hein appears and vows to wipe out all users of psychological abilities in existence, calling herself a reaper of justice. Follow Luciana as she is targeted by the reaper Hein for one month in a series of brutal murders, and discover three mysterious women who enter her life, changing it forever.

"How many times do I have to remind you? This is not a game, Luciana."

[From [url=https://occultlily.itch.io/shangri-enfer-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“如果我没有这种力量就好了……”

欢迎来到香格里拉；这里的人们优先考虑逻辑而非情感，有些人天生具有心理能力，具体取决于每个人的心理能力。正因为如此，Shangri;Enfer的犯罪率很低，因此抢劫或袭击等事件很少发生。然而，这种和平是短暂的，当一个名叫海因的神秘人物出现时，他发誓要消灭所有存在的心理能力使用者，称自己为正义的收割者。跟随卢西亚娜，在一个月的时间里，她在一系列残酷的谋杀案中成为收割者海因的目标，并发现三名神秘的女性进入了她的生活，永远改变了她的生活。

“我得提醒你多少次了？这不是游戏，卢西亚娜。”
